messages:
deploybot: RELEASE CHECK FAILED for release/2024-04-18-rc. Blocked by env-parity-check. Failures:
- secret INFERENCE_API_KEY namespace mismatch (staging: inference-service, prod: inference-service-v2)
- pinned model variant mismatch (staging: gptx-1.2-qt, prod: gptx-1.3-qt)
Action: release put on hold until parity is resolved.

dave_rm: ugh. where did the namespace change come from? we didn't touch secrets in this rollout. any quick mitigation?

carla_sre: deploybot logs show the secret path in prod was migrated last month during the keystore cleanup (#PR 482). staging wasn't included in that migration.
- log snippet: `env-checker: prod:/secrets/inference-service-v2/INFERENCE_API_KEY != staging:/secrets/inference-service/INFERENCE_API_KEY`

ben_eng: model pin mismatch is weirder. looks like CI pinned gptx-1.2-qt on the canary job, but prod already bumped to 1.3 in a hotpatch. ci/configs/pins.yaml still references 1.2 for this service.

alice_platform: so two independent parity drifts landed. both low-risk to fix but we need to decide: 1) backfill staging to match prod, 2) pin prod down temporarily, or 3) patch deploybot to allow tolerant mapping for this release window. Thoughts on rollback risk?

megan_prodsec: from a compliance/KMS perspective we prefer not to alter prod. Backfilling staging to match prod's keystore/KMS alias is cleaner. But confirm KMS alias policies — prod uses alias `projects/…/alias/inference-v2` while staging uses `inference-old`.

carla_sre: +1 to backfill staging. I can run a one-off secret-copy (read-only KMS decrypt in prod, encrypt into staging) but need approval because it's cross-namespace secret ops. will take ~15-20m including verification.

ben_eng: model pin: we can update ci/pins.yaml in the release branch to 1.3 and re-run preflight. quick change, no infra risk.

alice_platform: if we go that route, we should add a short-lived release note and an annotation that the staging keystore was synced to prod for parity. also update the preflight checklist so deploybot flags keystore migration PRs for both envs next time.

megan_prodsec: approving cross-namespace copy for parity only. please record audit steps and use ephemeral service account.

carla_sre: starting secret sync now. will run with `tools/secret-sync --from prod --to staging --secret INFERENCE_API_KEY --sa runbook-sync-2024-04-18` and post verification checks.

deploybot: ACTION: preflight re-check queued after manual interventions.

(8 minutes later)

carla_sre: secret sync completed. verification: staging:/secrets/inference-service-v2/INFERENCE_API_KEY exists and fingerprint matches prod. `sha256sum` verified.

ben_eng: updated ci/pins.yaml -> gptx-1.3-qt in release branch and re-ran preflight. canary job now uses 1.3.

deploybot: PRECHECKS: all env-parity checks PASS. Release unblocked.

alice_platform: proceeding with canary rollout in change window. heads-up: canary for 10%, 15m observation. I'll publish a short release note update on the workspace: "Release 2024-04-18: model pin gptx-1.3-qt; staging keystore synced to prod for parity; monitored canary 10%"

dave_rm: thanks, team. good catch. let's not forget a quick follow-up: create a tiny infra task to ensure keystore migration scripts run for staging during prod migrations. also add a preflight rule so deploybot flags single-env keystore changes.

megan_prodsec: filing PRODSEC-312 to track the keystore migration policy and audit trail.

carla_sre: leaving notes in the runbook and tagging the sync run: `runbook/keystore-sync#2024-04-18`

ben_eng: postmortem? low severity but two independent parity drifts should be consolidated. suggest 30min sync discussion tomorrow.

alice_platform: :thumbsup: canary passed 15m, metrics look stable, promoting to 50% now.

deploybot: rollout promoted to 50%.

(20 minutes later)

alice_platform: final: rollout to 100% completed. Release 2024-04-18 deployed.

dave_rm: closing thread — documented actions: secret sync run, ci pin update, preflight rule created (PR opened), PRODSEC ticket filed, runbook updated. Thanks everyone.

megan_prodsec: :white_check_mark:

carla_sre: will schedule the short follow-up to avoid recurrence.

ben_eng: noted for the release notes and changelog entry.

-- end of thread --
